## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-ABB-CAT-2.N.NN'
guidance_name: '{security_capability_name} ABB Catalog'
guidance_type: 'abb-catalog'
adm_phase: 'Phase B-D'
category: 'security'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: 'enterprise'
tags: ['security', '<capability-tag>', 'abb-catalog', 'phase-b', 'phase-c', 'phase-d']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B–D**: This catalog is the traceability reference for all Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs) defined within the {security_capability_name} domain. Each row maps an ABB to its parent L2 capability, TOGAF phase, and paired Reference Architecture Document (RAD).
>
> **ABBs are solution- and vendor-agnostic.** They define *what* architectural capability must exist, not *how* it is implemented. Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) are defined in Phase E–F and are not recorded here.

## Status Vocabulary

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `draft` | Authored but not yet reviewed |
| `review` | Under architecture review |
| `active` | Approved and available for realization |
| `deprecated` | Superseded — do not use for new designs |

## Reading Order

```
<GUID-SEC-*-VISION-0.N.NN>.md     (1) Architecture Vision — start here
<GUID-SEC-*-CAP-MAP-0.N.NN>.md    (2) L1/L2 Capability Map
<GUID-SEC-*-CAP-DESC-0.N.NN>.md   (3) Capability Descriptions
<GUID-SEC-*-ABB-1.N.NN>.md        (4) Composite ABB
<GUID-SEC-*-ABB-CAT-2.N.NN>.md (5) This document — ABB traceability
[Component ABBs]                   (6) Per capability area (see table above)
ref-arch/[RADs]                    (7) Reference Architectures
```
